name: Lena Pillars Nature Park
description: Along the banks of the Lena River in central Yakutia, in far eastern Siberia, jagged rock pillars rise about 100 metres like a stone wall, split by steep gullies. Winter cold of –60 °C and summer heat of +40 °C cracked the cliffs apart over time. The park lies roughly 180 km from Yakutsk, and its rocks also hold Cambrian fossils, some found nowhere else.
